product.name: STEFAN
product.introText: STEFAN chair, solid pine, brown-black. Assembly instructions AA-21977-11. Work on a soft surface (e.g. a rug). Tools: Allen key (included), Phillips screwdriver, awl.
product.partsSummary: 1x Allen key,  1x Apron front,  1x Apron rear,  1x Backrest,  6x Bolt,  4x Bracket,  14x Dowel,  4x Screw,  1x Seat,  2x Side frame

steps.title: Fit the seat brackets
steps.text: Push 4 seat brackets (122620) into the front and rear rails, 2 per rail, from the inner side. Leave them loose - they are pushed up against the seat in step 8.

steps.title: Rear rail onto the first side frame
steps.text: Lay one side frame flat on the floor. Tap 4 dowels (101350) into the ends of the rear rail, then fit the rail into the side frame at the bend of the back leg. Check the bracket orientation: both brackets must face inwards (see inset).

steps.title: Front rail
steps.text: Tap 4 dowels into the ends of the front rail and fit it into the front leg of the same side frame, brackets facing inwards.

steps.title: Backrest
steps.text: Tap 6 dowels into the backrest: 2 in each end of the top rail and 1 in each end of the lower rail. Fit the backrest into the upper part of the back leg.

steps.title: Second side frame and 3 bolts
steps.text: Place the second side frame on top so all dowels enter their holes. Fasten it with 3 bolts (104322) using the Allen key: one into the backrest top rail, one into the rear rail and one into the front rail.

steps.title: Turn over, 3 more bolts
steps.text: Turn the chair over onto the other side frame and fasten the first side frame with the remaining 3 bolts.

steps.title: Lower the frame onto the seat
steps.text: Lay the seat upside down on a table. Turn the frame upside down and lower it onto the seat, letting the backrest hang over the table edge. Centre it so the gaps at the front corners are equal on both sides.

steps.title: Push the brackets against the seat
steps.text: Slide all 4 seat brackets until they press firmly against the underside of the seat (the bracket must touch the seat, not stand off it - see inset).

steps.title: Screw the seat on
steps.text: Mark each hole with an awl, then drive 4 screws (122925) through the brackets into the seat with a Phillips screwdriver.

steps.title: Done - turn the chair upright
steps.text: Turn the chair the right way up and put it on the floor. If the chair ever feels loose, retighten the bolts with the Allen key.
